theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠

battle.name: 波斯灣戰爭
battle.theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠
battle.brief: 1990年8月2日凌晨，伊拉克以逾十萬兵力入侵科威特，兩日內攻陷首都；安理會第678號決議授權多國部隊，1991年1月17日聯軍發動「沙漠風暴」空襲，39天後地面部隊自科威特西南迂回，2月28日迫使伊軍投降。卡面那門1850年德國線膛野戰砲代表火砲作為軍隊骨幹的傳統，本役砲兵已由自走榴彈炮與多管火箭炮接棒。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 1990年8月2日開火，到1991年2月28日停火，交戰方大致分三層。第一層是伊拉克與科威特：伊拉克陸軍以第三、第四、第五軍團共十餘個師投入科威特方向，兵力約十萬至十二萬人，配約一千輛坦克與逾兩千輛裝甲車；共和國衛隊第一、第二機械化師與第三裝甲師「哈姆拉比」部署在巴士拉以南作預備，伊拉克空軍有數百架戰機與攻擊機，火箭炮兵集中在南部，岸基飛彈連鎖部署於巴士拉與烏姆薩拉一線。科威特軍隊約萬人，三個旅分散守備南部與首都方向，裝甲與航空兵力有限，國王私人武裝亦參與防衛。第二層是美國為主的聯合部隊：美軍中央司令部司令赫·諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將統合全局，沙烏地阿拉伯、埃及、敘利亞等國派地面部隊，英法等國派海空力量，科威特流亡政府組織臨時政府與軍團，另有加拿大、義大利、西班牙、荷蘭、波蘭、捷克、阿曼、巴基斯坦、孟加拉、卡塔爾、阿拉伯聯合大公國等數十國加入，總兵力逾九十五萬人。第三層是未參戰但提供情報與外交支持的以色列與歐洲盟國。聯軍海軍在波斯灣與紅海各組一個打擊群，各國空軍則在沙烏地阿拉伯、卡塔爾、巴林與土耳其等基地分區展開。
countriesEn: The war opened on 2 August 1990 and closed with the ceasefire of 28 February 1991, and the belligerents fall roughly into three layers. The first was Iraq against Kuwait: the Iraqi army committed the Third, Fourth and Fifth Army Corps, more than ten divisions in all, with 100,000 to 120,000 men, about a thousand tanks and more than two thousand armoured vehicles; the Republican Guard's First and Second Mechanised Divisions and the Third Armoured Division 'Hammurabi' were held in reserve south of Basra; the Iraqi air force fielded several hundred fighters and strike aircraft; rocket artillery was massed in the south; and surface-to-surface missile batteries were chained along the Basra and Umm Qasr line. The Kuwaiti army numbered about 10,000 men in three brigades spread thinly over the southern and capital fronts, with limited armour and aviation, and the emir's own guard took part in the defence. The second layer was the American-led coalition: overall command lay with General H. Norman Schwarzkopf Jr. of US Central Command; Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Syria supplied ground forces; Britain and France provided maritime and air power; the government-in-exile in Kuwait organised a provisional administration and corps; and a further score of states — Canada, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Poland, Czechoslovakia, Oman, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates among them — joined in, for a total above 950,000 personnel. The third layer comprised states that stayed out of the fighting but lent intelligence and diplomatic support, Israel among them. Coalition naval forces formed a strike group in the Persian Gulf and another in the Red Sea, and the air forces of the member states were distributed across bases in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Turkey.
people: 關鍵人物集中在四個位置。伊拉克方面，總統薩達姆·侯賽因是全部決策的核心，他兼任武裝部隊最高委員會主席，主導7月15日致阿拉伯聯盟會議的信件、7月31日最後通牒與8月2日的開火命令，並在8月2日宣布廢黜科威特埃米爾、扶立其堂弟賈貝爾·阿赫邁德·阿爾薩巴赫；其子古塞·侯賽因主持總統府警衛部隊與特別共和國衛隊。軍隊層面的關鍵人物有伊拉克軍參謀長穆罕默德·穆薩，以及共和國衛隊機械化師與第三裝甲師的師長，他們指揮了巴士拉方向的裝甲反擊。科威特方面，流亡的埃米爾賈貝爾·阿赫邁德·阿爾薩巴赫在海外代表國家，西部軍區司令薩阿德·阿爾阿提亞中將隨聯軍作戰直至國土收復。聯軍方面，美軍中央司令部司令施瓦茨科普夫上將是唯一的戰爭指揮者，東中部空軍司令部司令查爾斯·霍納中將負責空中戰役，第七軍團軍長弗雷德里克·弗蘭克斯少將與第十八空降軍團軍長加里·盧克中將指揮地面迂回，海軍陸戰隊第一遠征軍司令沃特·布默中將負責科威特正面，海軍中將斯坦利·阿瑟統管海空協同。英國由彼得·德拉·比利埃爾中將指揮海灣司令部，法國由米歇爾·泰齊耶中將指揮「諾曼第」軍，埃及派出裝甲師，沙烏地阿拉伯由蘇勒坦親王率領。
peopleEn: Four seats of decision carried the campaign. On the Iraqi side President Saddam Hussein was the centre of everything: as chairman of the Supreme Command of the Armed Forces he shaped the letter of 15 July to the Arab League summit, the ultimatum of 31 July and the order to fire on 2 August, and on that same day he deposed the emir of Kuwait and installed his cousin Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah; his son Qusay headed the Presidential Guard and the Special Republican Guard. At army level the key figures included the chief of staff Muhammad Musa and the commanders of the Republican Guard mechanised divisions and of the Third Armoured Division, who directed the armoured counter-attack towards Basra. For Kuwait the exiled emir Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah represented the state abroad, while the commander of the Western Command, Lieutenant General Saad al-Attiyah, fought alongside the coalition until the country was retaken. On the coalition side General Schwarzkopf was the single war commander; Lieutenant General Charles Horner ran the air campaign out of Central Command Air Forces; Major General Frederick Franks Jr. of VII Corps and Lieutenant General Gary Luck of XVIII Airborne Corps directed the ground hook; Lieutenant General Walter Boomer commanded the I Marine Expeditionary Force on the Kuwait axis; and Admiral Stanley Arthur coordinated the maritime and air effort. Britain was led by Lieutenant General Sir Peter de la Billière, France by Lieutenant General Michel Tézier, Egypt committed an armoured division, and Saudi Arabia fielded troops under Prince Sultan.
kits: 卡面那門1850年的德國線膛野戰砲，代表的是近代野戰砲兵的原型：一門由六至八人炮組操作、靠騾馬挽具牽引、備有前車與彈藥車的野戰砲，作為炮兵連的基本火力單位。1850年前後的德意志諸邦正把滑膛口裝砲逐步換成線膛口裝砲，射程因此由數百米推到數公里，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵。同一概念在1990至1991年的波斯灣戰爭中已由完全不同的裝備接棒：聯軍以M109A1自走式155公厘榴彈炮為骨幹，搭配M114拖曳式155公厘榴彈炮、英國自行155公厘炮、法國155公厘自行炮與德國PzH 2000自行榴彈炮，射程自二十二至三十公里起跳，遠非口裝線膛砲可比；多管火箭炮以M270為代表，另配BM-21式122公厘與130公厘火箭炮，用以打擊縱深與集群目標。伊拉克則保有數百門122、130、152公厘榴彈炮與逾一千門火箭發射車，其中BM-21式130公厘火箭炮集中在南部，逐次發射的火箭彈成為聯軍空襲初期的主要目標。裝甲方面，聯軍以M1A1主戰坦克、M2步兵戰鬥車與M3騎兵戰車為核心，伊拉克以T-62與T-72為主。空軍是F-15E、F-16、A-10、F-117A、B-52與E-3預警機、E-8電子戰機構成的打擊體系，並配「愛國者」防空飛彈與「戰斧」巡飛飛彈。
kitsEn: The 1850 German muzzle-loading field gun on the card is the archetype of the modern field artillery piece: a gun worked by a crew of six to eight, towed by mule and horse teams, with a limber and ammunition wagon behind it, serving as the basic firing unit of an artillery battery. Around 1850 the German states were replacing smoothbore muzzle loaders with rifled muzzle loaders, and the doubling of range from a few hundred metres to several kilometres gave artillery the first clear win over infantry in range. That same concept was carried by entirely different equipment in the Persian Gulf War of 1990 and 1991: the coalition built on the M109A1 155 mm self-propelled howitzer, backed by the M114 towed 155 mm howitzer, the British self-propelled 155 mm gun, the French 155 mm self-propelled gun and the German PzH 2000, with ranges starting at twenty-two to thirty kilometres and so far beyond anything a muzzle loader could reach; multiple rocket launchers were represented by the M270, supported by BM-21 122 mm and 130 mm systems for depth and mass targets. Iraq retained several hundred 122, 130 and 152 mm howitzers and more than a thousand rocket launchers, the BM-21 130 mm launchers massed in the south, whose ripple-fire salvos became the coalition's principal target in the opening phase of the air campaign. On armour the coalition centred on the M1A1 main battle tank, the M2 infantry fighting vehicle and the M3 cavalry fighting vehicle, while Iraq fought with T-62s and T-72s. In the air the strike system was built from F-15Es, F-16s, A-10s, F-117As and B-52s, with E-3 airborne warning and E-8 electronic warfare aircraft, Patriot surface-to-air missiles and Tomahawk land-attack cruise missiles.
tactics: 1990年8月2日的入侵本身就是一次教科書式的密集砲兵與裝甲突擊：伊拉克在邊境一線集中數百門火炮實施短時間火力準備，十餘個師在三個方向同時壓上，科威特各旅在縱深不足的情況下被逐個壓垮，四十八小時內全線崩解。1991年1月17日起的空襲分三段：先以低空突入的「黑洞」戰術打掉伊拉克雷達與地空飛彈陣地，首夜即摧毀地面戰機三十九架並擊落八架米格；隨後轉為晝夜連續滾動的壓制射擊，逐日削弱伊拉克空軍、飛彈發射車與地面部隊；再以「戰斧」與空軍對地攻擊封鎖南部縱深。地面階段自2月24日起僅歷時四天，第七軍團與第十八空降軍團自科威特西南方向實施數百公里的「左勾拳」迂回，穿越伊拉克南部沙漠直插巴士拉方向；海軍陸戰隊第一遠征軍在正面牽制，四個美國師在南面實施迂迴切斷，2月18日至19日以空降與空中機動攻佔巴士拉河口島嶼，堵死伊軍退路。砲兵在本役中被稱為主角，聯軍以多管火箭炮密集打擊伊拉克火箭炮陣地，並以自走榴彈炮對縱深目標實施連續火力準備，2月28日第十一裝甲師特遣隊受降，繳獲大批坦克、火砲與卡車。
tacticsEn: The invasion of 2 August 1990 was itself a textbook massed barrage followed by an armoured assault: the Iraqis massed several hundred guns on the border for a short preparation fire, pushed more than ten divisions in on three axes at once, and rolled up the Kuwaiti brigades one by one in a force with no depth, so that the whole line came apart within forty-eight hours. The air campaign that opened on 17 January 1991 ran in three stages. First came the low-level 'black hole' raid against Iraqi radar and surface-to-air missile sites, which destroyed thirty-nine aircraft on the ground and shot down eight MiGs in the opening night. The campaign then rolled on continuously, day and night, degrading the Iraqi air force, the missile launchers and the ground forces in turn. Finally Tomahawks and air-to-ground strikes sealed the southern approaches. The ground phase lasted only four days from 24 February: VII Corps and XVIII Airborne Corps swung hundreds of kilometres to the west out of Kuwait and across the southern Iraqi desert in a hook towards Basra, while the I Marine Expeditionary Force held the front and four American divisions cut the road behind; on 18 and 19 February airborne and air-assault forces seized the islands at the mouth of the Shatt al-Arab and closed the Iraqi withdrawal route. Artillery was the protagonist of the campaign: the coalition hammered Iraqi rocket launchers with multiple rocket launchers and kept up continuous preparation fire against depth targets with self-propelled howitzers, and on 28 February the task force of the 11th Armoured Division took surrender, recovering tanks, guns and trucks in bulk.
data: 時間：1990年8月2日開火，1991年2月28日停火，全役約七個月，其中空襲三十九天，地面戰四天。兵力：聯軍總兵力逾九十五萬人，美軍出動約六十九萬七千人；伊拉克常備軍約五十萬至六十五萬人，入侵科威特方向投入十萬至十二萬人；科威特軍隊約一萬人。裝備：伊拉克入侵時投入約一千輛坦克與逾兩千輛裝甲車，聯軍在戰區最終部署約四千輛坦克與八千餘輛裝甲車，另有各型火炮逾兩千門。空襲：首日聯軍出動約一千四百架次，日均維持一千一百至一千四百架次，空襲階段共發射「戰斧」巡飛飛彈約八百枚。火力量產與消耗方面，聯軍摧毀或擊傷伊拉克「地對地」飛彈逾一千枚。損失：聯軍共損失固定翼飛機約一百架、直升機約二十架，美軍陣亡一百四十八人、受傷約一千六百人；伊拉克空軍損失逾四百架飛機，多數在地面被毀，地面部隊損失以數千輛坦克與逾兩千門火炮計，俘虜約一萬七千人。繳獲：2月28日第七軍團第十一裝甲師特遣隊受降伊拉克第三裝甲師，繳獲或接收坦克一百四十八輛、火砲一千五百八十六門、卡車一千九百六十六輛。油價：戰前每桶原油約十七美元，1991年初北海布倫特一度升穿每桶四十美元。
dataEn: Duration: the fighting opened on 2 August 1990 and the ceasefire came on 28 February 1991, about seven months in all, of which thirty-nine days were spent in the air and four on the ground. Manpower: the coalition fielded more than 950,000 personnel, of whom about 697,000 were American; Iraq had a regular army of roughly 500,000 to 650,000 men and committed 100,000 to 120,000 to the invasion of Kuwait; the Kuwaiti army numbered about 10,000. Equipment: Iraq committed about a thousand tanks and more than two thousand armoured vehicles to the invasion, while the coalition eventually deployed about four thousand tanks, more than eight thousand armoured vehicles and over two thousand guns of all types in the theatre. Air: the coalition flew about 1,400 sorties on the first day and sustained between 1,100 and 1,400 a day, and the air campaign saw the firing of some eight hundred Tomahawk land-attack cruise missiles. The campaign also destroyed or damaged more than a thousand Iraqi surface-to-surface missiles. Losses: the coalition lost about a hundred fixed-wing aircraft and twenty helicopters, and the Americans counted 148 dead in action and some 1,600 wounded; the Iraqi air force lost more than four hundred aircraft, most of them destroyed on the ground, while ground losses ran to several thousand tanks and more than two thousand guns, and about 17,000 prisoners were taken. Captured: on 28 February the task force of the 11th Armoured Division of VII Corps took the surrender of the Iraqi Third Armoured Division and recovered or received 148 tanks, 1,586 guns and 1,966 trucks. Oil: crude stood near seventeen dollars a barrel before the war and North Sea Brent briefly pushed above forty dollars a barrel in early 1991.
cause: 導火索是石油。1986年國際油價崩跌，沙烏地阿拉伯轉向以低價大量增產維持市場，伊拉克的石油收入隨之銳減，而八年海灣戰爭留下的債務無力償還，伊拉克欠科威特約七十億美元、欠沙烏地阿拉伯約三百五十億美元。1990年7月，薩達姆·侯賽因指控科威特在魯梅拉油田低價超產、盜取伊拉克的石油，並由西北邊境偷接輸油管盜走原油，7月15日至19日雙方在邊境爆發小規模交火。7月15日他致函阿拉伯聯盟二十二國會議，指控科威特、阿拉伯聯合大公國與沙烏地共產原油欺騙產油國；7月31日在巴格達召開最高層會議後下達最後通牒，要求科威特就債務與產量作出讓步，未獲回應，遂於8月2日出兵。深層原因是八年間的戰爭把伊拉克的經濟與軍力推到極限，國內通貨膨脹、軍費失控、軍隊裝備過時，執政者需要用軍事勝利與掠奪財富轉移壓力；出兵之後，抵抗在國內被一律當作叛國處理。
causeEn: The spark was oil. When international prices collapsed in 1986, Saudi Arabia turned to heavy output at low prices to hold the market, and Iraq's oil revenue fell with them, while the debt left by eight years of war went unpaid: Iraq owed Kuwait about seven billion dollars and Saudi Arabia some thirty-five billion. In July 1990 Saddam Hussein accused Kuwait of over-producing at low prices in the Rumaila field, of taking Iraqi oil outright, and of siphoning crude across the north-west border through a tapping into the pipeline; small clashes broke out on the frontier between 15 and 19 July. On 15 July he sent a letter to the twenty-two-state Arab League summit, accusing Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia of colluding to flood the market and cheat the oil producers; on 31 July he chaired the supreme command meeting in Baghdad and issued an ultimatum demanding that Kuwait give way on the debts and on output, and when no reply came the invasion followed on 2 August. The deeper cause was that eight years of war had pushed the Iraqi economy and army to their limit, with runaway inflation, uncontrolled military spending and an army whose equipment had aged; those in power needed a military victory and seized wealth to redirect the pressure, and once the troops were in, resistance inside Iraq was uniformly treated as treason.
impact: 這場戰爭重塑了戰後二十年的中東格局與現代戰爭樣貌。國際法上，聯合國安理會第660號決議譴責伊拉克，第678號決議授權多國部隊，第687號決議要求伊拉克接受解除武裝、監督與核查委員會的核查，制裁與封鎖隨之實施，伊拉克由此長期被排除在國際經濟體系之外，直至2003年。軍事上，本役被視為冷戰後多國聯合作戰的樣本：隱形突防、精確導引、連續空襲與制空權完全主導地面戰，三十九天空襲摧毀伊拉克大部分現代化裝備，四天地面戰即告結束，這套經驗被後來科索沃與伊拉克戰爭反覆引用，成為「海灣戰爭神話」及其後反思的源頭。區域與後果層面，伊拉克撤軍時縱火破壞約七百口油井，油火燃燒數月，污染大片沙漠；1991年3月北部什葉派庫德人起義，又引出聯軍的「提供承諾」空運與聯合國人道干預，使伊拉克北部局勢長期動盪。能源市場上油價一度逼近每桶四十美元，1990年代初的能源危機改變了石油出口國的財政結構。中國方面則首次以實兵身份派出工程兵部隊赴海灣各國執行保障任務，成為中國軍隊第一次大規模參與海外行動。
impactEn: This war reshaped the Middle Eastern order of the following two decades and set the pattern of modern warfare. In international law, Security Council Resolution 660 condemned Iraq, Resolution 678 authorised the multinational force, and Resolution 687 required Iraq to accept the inspection of the United Nations Special Commission on Disarmament, Sanctions and Monitoring; the embargo and blockade followed, and Iraq was kept outside the world economic system until 2003. Militarily the campaign became the model for post-Cold War coalition war: stealth penetration, precision guidance, continuous air strikes and air supremacy dominated the ground phase, thirty-nine days of aerial bombardment destroyed most of Iraq's modern equipment, and the ground war ended in four days. The experience was cited again and again in Kosovo and later in Iraq, and became the source of the 'Gulf War myth' and of the rethinking that followed it. On the regional and human level, the withdrawing Iraqi forces set fire to some seven hundred oil wells, whose flames burned for months and blackened large areas of desert; the Shia Kurdish rising in the north in March 1991 then provoked the coalition airlift 'Operation Provide Comfort' and United Nations humanitarian intervention, and left northern Iraq unsettled for years. In the energy market oil pushed close to forty dollars a barrel, and the energy crisis of the early 1990s changed the fiscal arithmetic of the oil exporters. On the Chinese side, engineering troops were sent to the Gulf states for the first time as an actual military deployment, the first large-scale Chinese participation in an overseas operation.

resultEn: On 28 February 1991 the Iraqi army, under the coalition's advance and a stand-down order, laid down its arms in an organised surrender: the Fifth Army Corps, the Republican Guard mechanised divisions and the Third Armoured Division capitulated in turn, and the coalition took large numbers of men and equipment on the southern front. Kuwait was taken over by coalition troops within days, and the exiled government returned to take office. The ceasefire line was broadly drawn along the Saudi-Kuwaiti border and the former Iraqi frontier; the Iraqi army withdrew to its own territory, and the coalition did not pass north of Basra or enter Baghdad. On 3 April 1991 Security Council Resolution 687 required Iraq to destroy its mass destruction weapons and submit to inspection, and in April 1992 the United Nations Special Commission on Disarmament, Sanctions and Monitoring was formally established and began its work, dismantling the Iraqi chemical and missile programmes. In April 1991 Iraq accepted the arrangement for a no-fly zone in the south, and the zone gradually replaced direct intervention as the principal means of dealing with Iraq. In overall terms the coalition destroyed the Iraqi Fourth and Fifth Army Corps and the main body of the Republican Guard, retook Kuwait and met the aims of Resolution 678 at a cost of 148 American dead; but Baghdad was not taken and Saddam Hussein's regime did not fall, and the unfinished business of the war — disarmament, the no-fly zone and the settlement of the aftermath — ran on into the following decade.
